##############################################################################
### CLOSE_CONTAINER ###
#######################
	cheatideas_close_container_script = {
		context_type = player_context

		window_name = "cheatideas_close_container"

		visible = {
			has_country_flag = cheatideas_enabled
		}

		effects = {
			cheatideas_close_button_click = {
				clr_country_flag = cheatideas_enabled
			}
		}
		
		triggers = {
			cheatideas_close_button_click = {
				has_country_flag = cheatideas_enabled
			}
		}
	}
